summary.text: Stephanie Trussell is the Republican candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 42, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Margaret DeLaRosa.
She was the Republican nominee for Lieutenant Governor of Illinois in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Trussell ran for Lieutenant Governor of Illinois in the November 8, 2022 general election and received 42.4 percent of the vote, compared with 54.9 percent for incumbent Democrat Juliana Stratton.
She advanced from the Republican primary for the District 42 seat on March 17, 2026.
